description: This file contains unit tests for the PermissionManager's location authorization logic in a macOS application. It tests different authorization statuses and whether they are correctly recognized as authorized or not.

classes.name: PermissionManagerLocationTests
classes.description: A test struct that verifies the correctness of location permission checks in the PermissionManager.

methods.name: authorizedAlways counts for both modes
methods.description: Tests that when the location authorization status is 'authorizedAlways', it is recognized as authorized regardless of the 'requireAlways' parameter.

methods.name: other statuses not authorized
methods.description: Tests that statuses such as 'notDetermined', 'denied', and 'restricted' are correctly identified as not authorized.
